risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. A moderate seasonal pattern is present. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is stable (Kendall tau 0.743), which favours a selective combination.
